answer: Someone therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The orchard counter is kept in thread and delta reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4006 identities would post 3832 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
